correctness.rationale: The explicit LCF graph has 24 vertices, 36 edges, girth 7, diameter 4, and distance histogram (36,72,144,24), all reconstructed by a bundled finite verifier. Every one of the 96 elementary K2 collapse pairs is verified free at removal and leaves precisely G. The distance-4 complement H is six vertex-disjoint induced 4-cycles, proving K3=Ind(H)=Ind(C4)^*6~=S5 without extrapolation. Exact inclusion maps give integral barcode multiplicities 23[0,1) in H0, 13[1,3) in H1, and 1[3,4) in H5. The natural full automorphism group has 32 elements; the signed permutation action on six 2-point join factors has character values +1 for 16 and -1 for 16. All 32 determinants agree with a distinct signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz computation on 728 cross-polytope simplices. These data and executable code are embedded and were run at current paths; independent validation remains not performed.

originality.rationale: The new claim is the radius-three graph-metric complex of the McGee cage, its full integral persistence barcode and its 32-element automorphism orientation character. The key distance-four complement is six disjoint four-cycles; no inspected same-object prior computes this. Adamaszek covers exactly the radius-two collapse by its 3r+1 girth bound, and that portion is explicitly not credited as original. A published McGee independence-complex S5 is Ind(G), not the new Ind(H), and a (3,8)-cage calculation concerns a different 30-vertex graph. Actual published-finding corpus queries and 111 accessible own-claim comparisons were made; unindexed equivalent computations remain an explicit residual risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed McGee graph-power computation or distance-four graph table could imply the exact radius-three homotopy and orientation formula.

value.rationale: The McGee graph is the unique minimal cubic (3,7)-cage, an intrinsically motivated extremal graph. Its metric thickening exhibits a sharp, non-obvious transition from 13 persistent one-cycles through radius two to one 5-sphere at radius three; the full integral persistence is thereby determined. The exact orientation character and rational quotient distinction are natural information invisible to Betti numbers and can inform comparisons with the Heawood and Tutte–Coxeter cages. This is a coherent complete classification for a canonical finite graph, not an arbitrary small-parameter table or a routine rediscovery of the established radius-two theorem.
